Hints: A linear function has form y=mx+b, including constant functions when m=0. A nonzero squared or cubed term is nonlinear; k/x with k≠0 is also nonlinear on x≠0.
Solution: A linear function has form y=mx+b, including constant functions when m=0. A nonzero squared or cubed term is nonlinear; k/x with k≠0 is also nonlinear on x≠0. The correct selection is $y = 4x + 3$. Requested answer: $y = 4x + 3$.

Solution: Build y=mx+b: b is the starting or fixed amount and m is the change per unit. A recurring loss has negative m. Substitute the requested time if an output is requested. y = 2(7) + 6 = 20 Calculation: 2 × 7+6 = 20. Requested answer: 20.
